items.briefing:
Australian authorities are raising two important alerts today. The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has warned that a popular IT management tool called N-able N-central is actively being exploited by attackers in Australia — if your organisation uses this software, ensure it is patched immediately. Separately, ASIC is cautioning Australians about a rise in AI-generated deepfake investment scams, where criminals use realistic fake videos and personas to steal money.

Mid-market organisations like many registered training organisations should also be aware that they represent the majority of ransomware victims globally, making everyday vigilance essential. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unsolicited investment opportunity online — even from someone who appears on video — verify their identity through official channels before engaging.

featured.title: ACSC warns of active exploitation targeting N-able N-central in Australia
